name: xTool F1 Ultra (GS003)
notes: Galvo laser with a 1064 nm fiber laser and a 455 nm blue diode; the newer F1 Ultra extension (xTool-f1-ultra-ext-2.0, device code GS003).
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension GS003 (exts/GS003), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 220 x 220); modules from defaultPower [20, 20] (redPower, laserPower), the labels 455-<W>W / 1064-<W>W and the fiber_ir_blue text key. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
